categories.label: Finish
categories.note: What has happened to the print since

items.t: Fresh off the press. Clean edges, full colour, one thumbprint in the margin.
Pinned to a corkboard for a year. Sun faded on one side, pin holes in the corners.
Folded into quarters and unfolded. Crease lines through the image, wear at the intersections.
Photocopied twice. Contrast blown out, greys gone to speckle.
Coffee ring in one corner, absorbed into the paper.
Torn from a larger sheet. One ragged edge, three cut edges.
Laminated badly. Air bubbles, one corner peeling.
Scanned crooked. A sliver of the scanner lid visible along one edge.
Stuck to a fridge. Magnet shadows at two corners, slightly curled at the bottom.
Printed on the wrong paper. Ink sitting on top, slightly beaded.
